matches.rationale: GT1 concerns the incorrect definition and ordering of encryption matrices P and Q in Equation (1). Pred_3 does mention Equation (1) and matrix multiplication complexity, but it addresses computational cost underestimation, not the logical inconsistency in the encryption/decryption mechanism that GT1 describes. Different defects in the same equation.

GT2 concerns the ill-formed leverage score formula in Equation (5) involving e_{i,j}^T and U_k^{(i)}. Pred_1 discusses Equation (6) and normalization/sampling issues, which is a different equation and different defect. No finding addresses the malformed vector-matrix multiplication in Equation (5).

GT3 describes inconsistent temperature scaling definitions between equations (7) and (9). Pred_2 directly identifies this inconsistency, noting that Eq. (7) applies separate softmax to old/new logits while Eq. (9) uses concatenated logits, and questions which loss is actually optimized. This is the same defect despite different technical framing.

Correctly detects GT3's inconsistency between temperature scaling formulations in equations (7) and (9).
